derivation: For a compact circle S^1 of radius R, KK momentum is p_11 = n hbar / R.
The corresponding 4D KK rest mass is m_KK = |p_11|/c = n hbar/(R c).
Set m_E = m_KK and use h = 2 pi hbar.
h f / c^2 = n hbar/(R c) => f = n c/(2 pi R).
Therefore R_n = n c/(2 pi f).

interpretation.established_part: KK reduction of higher-dimensional theories produces lower-dimensional massive KK states; M-theory has an 11D description and compactification to lower dimensions.
interpretation.hypothesis_part: Identifying the specific 7.83 Hz frequency with the n=1 KK mode of an M-theory compact dimension is a new model assumption, not an established M-theory result.
interpretation.important_boundary: The calculated radius is conditional on the identification; it is not a measured M-theory compactification radius.

prediction_test: Specify the compactification manifold and radius R independently.
Check whether the lowest mode gives f=7.83 Hz.
Require consistency with experimental constraints on extra dimensions.
Require an inverse mapping from observed frequency to compactification parameters.

inside_out_solution.step_1_observation: f1 = 7.83 Hz is an observed Earth-ionosphere Schumann resonance frequency.
inside_out_solution.step_2_ideal_spherical_mode: f_n = (c/(2*pi*R_E))*sqrt(n(n+1)) for an ideal lossless spherical cavity.
inside_out_solution.step_3_mode_1_earth: Using R_E=6371 km gives f_ideal,n1 ≈ 10.5913 Hz.
inside_out_solution.step_4_environmental_correction: The observed/ideal ratio is eta≈0.73929, representing effective propagation/boundary losses in this simplified parametrization; it is not a new fundamental constant.
inside_out_solution.step_7_KK_reparameterization: If the same frequency is instead represented as a light-speed n=1 KK circle mode, R_11=c/(2*pi*f)=6093.672 km.
inside_out_solution.step_8_comparison: R_11/R_E≈0.95647. Thus the inferred KK circle scale is Earth-radius scale, not a microscale extra dimension.
inside_out_solution.step_9_m_theory_boundary: M-theory supports an 11D framework and circle compactification can produce KK momentum states, but the data do not select 7.83 Hz as an M-theory mode.
inside_out_solution.result: The mapping can be solved mathematically as a conditional KK parameter inference, but it is not a derivation that 7.83 Hz physically originates from M-theory.

required_new_physics: An explicit 11D metric/compactification with independently specified R_11 or equivalent moduli.
A physical field whose n=1 KK excitation couples to the observed Schumann resonance.
A predicted frequency from the 11D model before using the observed 7.83 Hz as an input.
Consistency with experimental constraints on large extra dimensions.
